purpose: Determine whether the pinned third-party 5-minute CU/RB/I transport source reproduces official exchange contract-day OHLC/volume/open-interest closely enough to be admitted to a later causal night-session feature experiment.

contracts.CU: May delivery contract for each year: CUYY05
contracts.RB: May delivery contract for each year: RBYY05
contracts.I: May delivery contract for each year: IYY05

fixed_crosscheck_sample.date_resolution: For each anchor and exchange, scan the anchor date and next four calendar days in order and choose the first date for which the official exchange daily endpoint returns the specified contract. No date is selected from third-party price agreement or CSI1000 behavior.

third_party_daily_aggregation.trading_day_mapping: For official trading date D, find the immediately preceding official exchange trading date P from official daily responses. Aggregate only positive-volume 5-minute bars for the fixed contract with timestamps strictly after P 15:00:00 and at or before D 15:00:00.
third_party_daily_aggregation.open: open of first positive-volume bar in the interval
third_party_daily_aggregation.zero_volume_bars: ignored for OHLC, volume and endpoint construction

comparison_tolerances.missing_or_zero_official_OHLC: check is unavailable rather than coerced

gates.gate_1_official_access: at least 30 of the 36 fixed checks must resolve to an official contract-day observation; otherwise source contract is insufficient for automated validation
gates.gate_2_price_match: at least 95% of available checks must match all four OHLC fields within frozen tolerance
gates.gate_3_volume_match: at least 95% of available checks must match official volume exactly
gates.gate_4_open_interest_match: at least 95% of available checks must match official open interest exactly
gates.gate_5_product_floor: each of CU, RB and I must have at least 8 available checks and at least 90% all-OHLC match rate; a failing product is invalidated individually and cannot enter the later feature model
gates.gate_6_no_target_model: this crosscheck reads no CSI1000 targets and computes no IC/R2/sign/model metrics

decision_rule.product_pass: eligible for a separately preregistered causal contract-selection/night-return construction; not yet admitted to a target model
decision_rule.product_fail: invalidate that product from this transport source and preserve failure; do not substitute another commodity after target results
decision_rule.all_products_fail: terminate this third-party transport source and search for a new authoritative/reproducible source before any domestic-night model experiment
